26.english_reference: that [ was ] by the sanctuary of the LORD

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ מִקְדַּ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἀπέναντι Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: quæ erat in sanctuário Dómini :
traditions.KJV: that [ was ] by the sanctuary of the LORD .

27.english_reference: And Joshua said unto all the people

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל כָּל הָ עָ֗ם
traditions.VUL: et dixit ad omnem pópulum :
traditions.KJV: And Joshua said unto all the people ,

27.english_reference: Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֨ה הָ אֶ֤בֶן הַ זֹּאת֙ תִּֽהְיֶה בָּ֣ נוּ לְ עֵדָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: En lapis iste erit vobis in testimónium ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us ;

27.english_reference: for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִ֣יא שָׁמְעָ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל אִמְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עִמָּ֑ נוּ
traditions.VUL: quod audíerit ómnia verba Dómini , quæ locútus est vobis :
traditions.KJV: for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us :

27.english_reference: it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָ֤ה בָ כֶם֙ לְ עֵדָ֔ה פֶּֽן תְּכַחֲשׁ֖וּ ן בֵּ אלֹהֵי כֶֽם
traditions.VUL: ne forte póstea negáre velítis , et mentíri Dómino Deo vestro .
traditions.KJV: it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .

28.english_reference: So Joshua let the people depart

traditions.WLC: וַ יְשַׁלַּ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶת הָ עָ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Dimisítque pópulum ,
traditions.KJV: So Joshua let the people depart ,

traditions.WLC: אִ֖ישׁ לְ נַחֲלָתֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: síngulos in possessiónem suam .
traditions.KJV: every man unto his inheritance .

29.english_reference: And it came to pass after these things

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֔לֶּה
traditions.VUL: Et post hæc
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass after these things ,

29.english_reference: that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the LORD , died

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: mórtuus est Iósue fílius Nun servus Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the LORD , died , [ being ]

29.english_reference: [ being ] an hundred and ten years old

traditions.WLC: בֶּן מֵאָ֥ה וָ עֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים
traditions.VUL: centum et decem annórum :
traditions.KJV: an hundred and ten years old .

30.english_reference: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹת וֹ֙ בִּ גְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔ וֹ בְּ תִמְנַת סֶ֖רַח
traditions.VUL: sepelierúntque eum in fínibus possessiónis suæ in Thamnáthsare ,
traditions.KJV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ הַר אֶפְרָ֑יִם
traditions.VUL: quæ est sita in monte Ephraim ,
traditions.KJV: which [ is ] in mount Ephraim ,

30.english_reference: on the north side of the hill of Gaash

traditions.WLC: מִ צְּפ֖וֹן לְ הַר גָּֽעַשׁ
traditions.VUL: a septentrionáli parte montis Gaas .
traditions.KJV: on the north side of the hill of Gaash .

31.english_reference: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ
traditions.VUL: Servivítque Israel Dómino cunctis diébus Iósue
traditions.KJV: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua ,

31.english_reference: and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹ֣ל יְמֵ֣י הַ זְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ
traditions.VUL: et seniórum , qui longo vixérunt témpore post Iósue ,
traditions.KJV: and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua ,

31.english_reference: and which had known all the works of the LORD , that he had done for Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדְע֗וּ אֵ֚ת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: et qui novérunt ómnia ópera Dómini quæ fécerat in Israel .
traditions.KJV: and which had known all the works of the LORD , that he had done for Israel .

32.english_reference: And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת עַצְמ֣וֹת י֠וֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱל֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל מִ מִּצְרַיִם֮ קָבְר֣וּ בִ שְׁכֶם֒
traditions.VUL: Ossa quoque Ioseph , quæ túlerant fílii Israel de Ægýpto , sepeliérunt in Sichem ,
traditions.KJV: And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem ,

32.english_reference: in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem

traditions.WLC: בְּ חֶלְקַ֣ת הַ שָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָנָ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב מֵ אֵ֛ת בְּנֵֽי חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי שְׁכֶ֖ם
traditions.VUL: in parte agri , quem émerat Iacob a fíliis Hemor patris Sichem ,
traditions.KJV: in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem

32.english_reference: for an hundred pieces of silver

traditions.WLC: בְּ מֵאָ֣ה קְשִׂיטָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: centum novéllis óvibus ,
traditions.KJV: for an hundred pieces of silver :

32.english_reference: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְי֥וּ לִ בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֖ף לְ נַחֲלָֽה
traditions.VUL: et fuit in possessiónem filiórum Ioseph .
traditions.KJV: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .

33.english_reference: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵ֑ת
traditions.VUL: Eleázar quoque fílius Aaron mórtuus est :
traditions.KJV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died ;

33.english_reference: and they buried him in a hill [ that pertained to ] Phinehas his son

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֗ וֹ בְּ גִבְעַת֙ פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בְּנ֔ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et sepeliérunt eum in Gábaath Phínees fílii eius ,
traditions.KJV: and they buried him in a hill [ that pertained to ] Phinehas his son ,

33.english_reference: which was given him in mount Ephraim

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּן ל֖ וֹ בְּ הַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם
traditions.VUL: quæ data est ei in monte Ephraim .
traditions.KJV: which was given him in mount Ephraim .
